quest.title: Wilting Weeping Willow
quest.description: You discover a great tree that resembles a wilting waterfall. What secrets lie here?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Mysterious Altar
dialogues.text: (Most of the inscription has been scratched out, but you can make out "...foam...")

talks.objective: Search for the "key" near the "Weeping Willow"

dialogues.speaker: Mysterious Altar
dialogues.text: (Most of the inscription has been scratched out, but you can make out "...foam...")

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What does that mean? It must be crucial to finding the key, right? Guess we need to figure out how to activate this altar...

talks.objective: Find a way to activate the altar
Examine the item on the altar
Examine the item on the altar

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And that's another key for us. Now all we need to do is find the final one.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Key, key, Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Pahsiv! Where did you come from?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Disappeared, Pahsiv.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay then... Paimon's never met a Melusine so unique... And Paimon thought Melusine all lived in the Court of Fontaine or Merusea Village. How come you're out here?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Court of Fontaine? Merusea Village?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You seem confused. Haven't you heard of those places?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Court of Fontaine, Melusine... Merusea Village, Melusine...

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Ah... Erinnyes, Pahsiv, home.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Erinnyes, Pahsiv, protect!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, you're saying that this is your home? And that you're protecting it?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But don't the Melusine live in Merusea Village?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes, that's kinda strange. Are some Melusine born elsewhere? Paimon can't see any others here though.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pahsiv, do you live here alone?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Alone? Melusine. New Valet! Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: New... Valet? There's a valet? Who?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #New... Valet! Paimon, Paimon, {NICKNAME}, {NICKNAME}. New Valet, New Valet!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So who is New Valet, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pahsiv... are you trying to say New Valet is called New Valet, like Paimon is called Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah-ha! I was right. Paimon's always said that she's clever, hasn't she?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: New Valet, Pahsiv, knowledge, ka-pow.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Err... you mean that New Valet is helping you learn things?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Pahsiv! Lots of. Language, wisdom... lots of.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Er, Paimon's not sure about the "lots of" bit...

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Pahsiv, New Valet, protect, ka-pow.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And he helps you protect this place?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Melusine...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You help him protect this place?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Pahsiv!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So that's it... But who is this New Valet? And why does he need you to help protect this place, anyway?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And some really bad things have happened here, too. We saw the stone tablet and how someone had scratched out the inscription, and lots of filth... Are there any enemies?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Curious Paimon, Pahsiv! But time very not lots of.

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Key, key, key, square, west, ka-pow, ka-pow.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We'll be as quick as we can!

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: #Paimon, Pahsiv! {NICKNAME}, Pahsiv!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Pahsiv gives two happy jumps and then leaves in a bit of a hurry.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It looks like we really are pressed for time. But we've already got two keys, so let's press on and get the third!

talks.objective: Investigate the large tree on the island
Remove the filth from the Dewfoam Flower

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: A glittering pearl of water appears on the altar.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Pahsiv scratches her head as she tries to understand, then gives two more happy jumps and leaves in a bit of a hurry.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: A glittering pearl of water appears on the altar.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, that drop of water... That can't be the treasure, can it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It doesn't look like treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's what Paimon thought. It can't be that easy. But what is it, then?

choices.text: Maybe it is key to containing the Demon King.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? But that means catastrophe! Quick, put it back. Paimon hopes we're not too late!
Ah...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh no! It's the Demon King!
The Demon King? Melusine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Gah, you gave Paimon a fright there... A Melusine, huh? What are you doing here?
Key.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Key? What key? Is this drop of water a key?
Pahsiv.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Err... The drop of water is Pahsiv?
Melusine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh! What do you mean? Is the drop of water a Melusine? Paimon's getting dizzy. What on earth is this? Aren't you the Melusine here?
Pahsiv...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Err... You're a Pahsiv? Or is your name Pahsiv? Wait... No, don't answer. You'll just make Paimon dizzier...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, Paimon's decided to call you Pahsiv. Is that okay?

response.speaker: Pahsiv?
response.text: Melusine...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}... What should we do? Paimon can't understand a thing she's saying. What is she trying to say?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You can understand what we're saying, can't you?

response.speaker: Pahsiv?
response.text: Pahsiv...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This drop of water is a key, right?

response.speaker: Pahsiv?
response.text: Pahsiv.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're not a human, are you?

response.speaker: Pahsiv?
response.text: Pahsiv!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Er... Let's not be rude all of a sudden, shall we?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm not a human, am I?

response.speaker: Pahsiv?
response.text: M—Melusine?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Wait! Paimon thinks she's starting to understand. "Pahsiv" is yes and "Melusine" is no. Could that be it?

response.speaker: Pahsiv?
response.text: Pahsiv! Pahsiv!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you're not called Pahsiv. Sorry, Paimon got your name wrong earlier.

response.speaker: Pahsiv?
response.text: Pahsiv... likes...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You like the name?

response.speaker: Pahsiv?
response.text: Pahsiv!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Wonderful! Then that's what Paimon's gonna call you, hehe. This is {NICKNAME}. We're glad to meet you, Pahsiv. Paimon's never met a Melusine like you.

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: #Paimon, Pahsiv! {NICKNAME}, Pahsiv!

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Erinnyes... Melusine...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...So you mean Erinn-no? Or... Err...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Something wrong with Erinnyes?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Erinnyes, Melusine, now...

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Pahsiv, Erinnyes, protect...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, something bad is happening to Erinnyes, and you want to protect it?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: #Paimon, {NICKNAME}, Erinnyes, ka-pow, ka-pow...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Err... So that's five words now. So... you want Paimon and {NICKNAME} to punch Erinnyes? Like KA-POW?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Melusine!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You want us to help?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Pahsiv!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, so she wants help from us. That's good. Paimon didn't know how we could punch Erinnyes, with it being a whole island and all...

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Ka-pow, ka-pow.

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Re... ward?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh come on, {NICKNAME}! Pahsiv can barely talk! She won't be able to find anyone else to help her, so we should just do it!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What do we need to do?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Key, key, key, number.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And then? How many keys is that, now?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Key! Key! Key!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Three keys?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Pahsiv! Key, foggy path, south...

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Key, spring, north...

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Key, willow, east...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, that's what you mean... Let's make a note real quick... Three keys in total, one in the southern foggy road, one in the northern spring, and one in the eastern willows... Is Paimon right?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Key, key, key, square, west.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And there are three keys in the square to the west?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Collect three keys and go to the square?

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: #Paimon, Melusine! {NICKNAME}, Pahsiv!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh c'mon, Pahsiv, do you have to always make it sound like {NICKNAME} is cleverer than Paimon? We're clearly of more or less equal intellect!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, we've already got one key, so all we need to do is find the remaining two.

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Erinnyes, Melusine... Pahsiv, protect!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Relax. Paimon doesn't know what's happened, but we're going to help you protect Erinnyes for sure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But if Paimon could add one small point, Pahsiv, Paimon would like to say that if you happen to see anything shiny, round, and unwanted, or some expensive-looking chest...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, it would be just wonderful if you could let us know!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Pahsiv scratches her head as she tries to understand, then gives two more happy jumps and leaves in a bit of a hurry.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh, she ran straight off. Guess she must have something really urgent to work on. {NICKNAME}, shall we go looking for those two keys now?

choices.text: What do we need to do?
Maybe someone else put it here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? Oh no, that makes us thieves. Ohh, Paimon's sorry... Let's put it back, quick.
Ah...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh no! The boss is back!
The boss? Melusine.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: A glittering pearl of water appears on the altar.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Awesome! Now, we have the third key.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Key, key, key!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Disappeared, Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #Paimon, Pahsiv! {NICKNAME}, Pahsiv! Key, key, key!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Square, west!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe. Is this what you're trying to say? Don't worry, we're going there now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This must be where the other key is hidden, right? Things certainly do seem odd around here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why don't we try and find the altar? The key should be on one, just like before.
